purpose: Single connected empty platform with physical upper and lower grooves; sampled as adjoining regions at runtime.

Observatory.prompt:
Create ONE empty physical game-platform architectural asset for Starfall Observatory, using the first reference for the CONNECTED CARVED UI RECESSES and the second for material. Finished painterly game art. Portrait 1:2 canvas. Transparent background outside the slab, no scenery. The asset will be rendered as three adjoining horizontal architectural sections, so every section must share straight continuous outer side joins near x=.025 and .975. The surface must be moonlit lavender moonstone with restrained aged brass edges. Nearly overhead shallow perspective with subtle front thickness. One continuous crafted slab, not three detached pieces.

Exact structure: the UPPER LEDGE occupies y=0 through .20. It contains ONE broad shallow carved groove whose QUIET MATTE EMPTY INTERIOR spans x=.08 through .92, y=.04 through .17. Its rounded but slightly irregular bevels and shadows show a real scooped depression in the same stone. No individual button shapes or symbol pockets: native score, forecast and menu will share this open groove.
The CENTRAL ARENA occupies y=.20 through .74, with uninterrupted quiet usable floor spanning x=.05 through .95. No back wall cutting into it. Its near-straight sides continue exactly from the upper ledge into the lower apron. Very shallow taper at most. Subtle painterly natural material grain ONLY; no grid, no cell lines, no emblems, no runes, no decorative marks, no stars.
The LOWER COMMUNICATION APRON occupies y=.74 through 1.0. It is physically attached to the same slab, with a broad organic shallow hollow. Its EMPTY QUIET INTERIOR spans x=.08 through .92, y=.77 through .98. It must be one broad readable surface, without separate avatar circles or buttons. Low engraved rim, small asymmetrical wear, depth and cast shadows, not a flat outlined software panel. The outer left/right walls keep the same x positions as the central arena. Tiny organic decoration may live on the extreme outer edges only, never inside the empty regions.

ABSOLUTELY NO LETTERING, NUMBERS, ICONS, PORTRAITS, CHARACTERS, GAME PIECES, BUTTON LABELS, SUNS, MOONS, TELESCOPES, LANTERNS OR OTHER INTERACTIVE PROPS. NO UI CARDS, NO SOLID NAVY/BLACK FILL, NO DETACHED ROUNDED RECTANGLE PANELS, NO OUTER DEVICE FRAME. It is a physical moonstone/ceramic/basalt/shellstone/slate platform with sculpted recesses, not a screenshot, concept sheet or mockup. Its muted shaded recesses keep the same material as the arena, darkened by depth and real light. Transparent pixels outside the physical platform. Avoid a heavy rigid cage: restrained curved/chipped physical edge, broad open floor, tasteful cozy cosmic craft.
